title: New location
content: So I’ve noticed a new location I’ve been going to a lot. It’s a HUGE gymnasium that’s supposed to be my old highschool. The bleachers go all the way up to the ceiling and it usually feels like there’s thousands of people in there. I’m for some reason always graduating again but something goes wrong during the walk or I am usually trying to sneak in. There’s usually winding hallways with lots of stairs connecting the classrooms to this gym. I know the mall is close by but they’re not connected. Anyone else?
